Subject: Block request: Redwood Exec Workshop (Dec 14-17)

Hi Megan / Grand Harbor team,

We're planning an in-person executive workshop for a key customer (Horizon Financial) and would like to hold a tentative room block at Grand Harbor the nights of Dec 13-17 (arrivals mainly Dec 14, departures Dec 17). Basic ask below — we can finalize counts next week but need a preliminary hold and rate for procurement.

- Room block: 28 total (18 king standard, 8 double-queen, 2 ADA king)
- Preferred rate: corporate/net quoted rate for government/finance clients (please flag any resort fees)
- VIPs: 2 arrivals with late-night check-in (after midnight) on Dec 14 — will need guaranteed keys / late check-in notes
- Meeting room: pre-booked independently (we'll handle AV) but need secure access after hours for a small delegation
- ADA / dietary needs: please reserve 2 ADA rooms near elevator and confirm fridge availability for 3 rooms (dietary meds)
- Deadline for hold: can you hold the rooms until Dec 1 and provide a preliminary rooming agreement?

I've attached our rooming requirements spreadsheet (basic template). If you can send a Block Confirmation PDF and the copy of the hotel's standard contract (DocuSign link preferred), that will help procurement move quickly.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if it's easier.

Marcus Lin
Events & Partnerships Program Lead
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0199
Attachment: 20261125-redwood-rooming-requirements.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks for reaching out; we'd be delighted to host Redwood's executive workshop. Preliminary details: we can hold the 28 rooms you requested at our corporate rate of $299/night (taxes & $25 resort fee extra). We will earmark: 18 King Standard, 8 Double-Queen, 2 ADA King (near elevator).

We can hold the block through Dec 1 without deposit. After that date, we require a 50% rooming guarantee or rooming list to convert to a definite block. VIP late arrivals are noted; we can pre-authorize cards and hold express check-in packets at the front desk.

Attachments: block_confirmation_gh_20261126.pdf (PDF) — this includes the tentative inventory, deposit deadlines, and our standard Master Account contract.

Questions:
- Do you need a private keycard access plan for after-hours meeting room access (we can provision temporary keycards tied to the master list)?
- Any shuttle requirements from SFO (we can provide quotes)?

If you want DocuSign for the master contract we'll send a link. Best,

Megan Santos
Conference Sales Manager
Grand Harbor Hotel
reservations@grandharborhotel.com
